description.zh: 实时投递sls的LogStoreName，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The name of the Logstore that collects log data from Alibaba Cloud CDN in real time. You can specify multiple Logstore names and separate them with commas (,).

description.zh: 实时投递sls的ProjectName，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The name of the Log Service project that is used for real-time log delivery. You can specify multiple project names and separate them with commas (,).

description.zh:
实时投递sls的地域，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。

地域详情请参见[实时日志投递用户Region列表](~~144883~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the Log Service project is deployed. You can specify multiple region IDs and separate them with commas (,).

For more information about regions, see [Regions that support real-time log delivery](~~144883~~).

title.zh: 查询实时日志投递域名

descriptions.en: > Each account can call this operation up to 100 times per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn list-realtime-log-delivery-domains --project ProjectName --logstore LogstoreName --biz-region ch-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn ListRealtimeLogDeliveryDomains --region cn-hangzhou --Project ProjectName --Logstore LogstoreName --Region 'ch-shanghai'
